title: Color applications / destination and journey
slide_intent: Demonstrate how a small accent can identify contrasting campaigns so color remains purposeful.
strategic_value: Red DB and sleeper accents can connect a bright destination offer with a dark photographic travel message.
demonstration: A light South Tyrol price poster sits beside a dark Berlin–Paris photograph with red brand accents.
practical_value: Compare a predominantly light offer with a predominantly dark image-led campaign.

content_islands.name: Destination offer
content_islands.spec: Place the price and mountain photograph on the light station poster at left.

content_islands.name: Journey message
content_islands.spec: Place the travelers, white city names and red accents in the dark composition at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The two campaign specimens apply the palette to light and dark communication.
